title: Derived-unit homology detected by all strict-local fibres
statement: Let f:X\to S be a scheme morphism and x a geometric point of X [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-geometric-point]. Let A=S_(fx) and B=X_(x), with their canonical map h:B\to A [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit, lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality]. Let K be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], u:Spec K\to A, and t its composite to S. Set E=A\times_S Spec K, Y=B\times_S Spec K, p:Y\to E and a:E\to Spec K [def-pc-fibre-product]. For an abelian etale sheaf F on Spec K and q\geq0 [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], let M be H^q of the derived unit a^{-1}F[0]\to Rp_*p^{-1}a^{-1}F[0] [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-exact-conservative]. Then M is an isomorphism if and only if H^q(Spec K,F)\to H^q(B\times_(A,v)Spec K,F) is bijective for every lift v:Spec K\to A of t [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. No torsion or finiteness hypothesis on F or f is imposed.

proof.text: Invertibility of M implies invertibility of every stalk by functoriality; for a given lift choose its corresponding point using the pointwise theorem. Conversely, use the lift for each point and the pointwise criterion to show its stalk map is invertible. Transfer along the canonical universe-lift stalk isomorphism and apply the conservative family of universe-lifted geometric points.

theorem strictLocalFibre_derivedUnit_iff
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsSepClosed K]
    (u : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme (x ≫ f))
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    let t := u ≫ Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap (x ≫ f)
    let p := pullback.map
      (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap x ≫ f) t
      (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap (x ≫ f)) t
      (Scheme.strictHenselizationMap f x) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by simpa using (Scheme.strictHenselizationMap_over f x).symm) (by simp)
    let a := pullback.snd (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap (x ≫ f)) t
    IsIso (derivedPullbackUnitHomology p
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} a).obj F) q) ↔
    ∀ v : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme (x ≫ f),
      v ≫ Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap (x ≫ f) = t →
      Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap
        (pullback.snd (Scheme.strictHenselizationMap f x) v) F q)
